metadata.question: Was the surface temperature at (63.8577134531586, -22.413665983340525) higher than Grindavik on January 16, 2024?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Terra (MOD11A1 v6.1) daily LST for 2024-01-16, fallback to Aqua (MYD11A1) if Terra unavailable. Regions: given point and Grindavík center point. Filter by date and region union.
2. Masking strategy: Apply MODIS LST QC_Day mandatory QA bits (0-1 == 00) for valid pixels. No separate cloud mask needed.
3. Logic for valid vs null: If collections empty -> C1. If valid pixel count per region == 0 -> C2. If computed LST is null/NaN or out of plausible range (-100 to 70 C) -> C3. Otherwise compare and answer A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const latA = 63.8577134531586;
    const lonA = -22.413665983340525; // Note: lon,lat order in ee.Geometry.Point
    const pointA = ee.Geometry.Point([lonA, latA]);

    // Approximate Grindavík town center
    const latG = 63.842;
    const lonG = -22.433;
    const pointG = ee.Geometry.Point([lonG, latG]);

    const region = pointA.buffer(1000).union(pointG.buffer(1000));
    const dateStart = '2024-01-16';
    const dateEnd = '2024-01-17';

    console.log(`Date window: ${dateStart} to ${dateEnd}`);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    let colTerra = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1')
      .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd)
      .filterBounds(region);
    let terraSize = colTerra.size().getInfo();

    console.log(`Terra MOD11A1 images: ${terraSize}`);

    let colAqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1')
      .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd)
      .filterBounds(region);
    let aquaSize = colAqua.size().getInfo();

    console.log(`Aqua MYD11A1 images: ${aquaSize}`);

    let usedColName = null;
    let img = null;

    if (terraSize > 0) {
      usedColName = 'MOD11A1 (Terra)';
      img = colTerra.mosaic();
    } else if (aquaSize > 0) {
      usedColName = 'MYD11A1 (Aqua)';
      img = colAqua.mosaic();
    } else {
      console.log('No daily MODIS LST images found for region/date.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Using: ${usedColName}`);

    // 3. Processing: QC mask and LST in Celsius
    const qa = img.select('QC_Day');
    const goodMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); // bits 0-1 == 00 => good
    const lstC = img.select('LST_Day_1km')
      .multiply(0.02)
      .subtract(273.15)
      .updateMask(goodMask)
      .rename('LST_C');

    // 4. Pixel counts to detect C2
    const countA = lstC.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: pointA.buffer(1000),
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get('LST_C').getInfo();

    const countG = lstC.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: pointG.buffer(1000),
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get('LST_C').getInfo();

    console.log(`Valid pixels - PointA: ${countA || 0}, Grindavik: ${countG || 0}`);

    if (!countA || !countG || countA === 0 || countG === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after QC mask for one or both points.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Calculation: mean LST for both
    const meanA = lstC.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: pointA.buffer(1000),
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get('LST_C').getInfo();

    const meanG = lstC.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: pointG.buffer(1000),
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get('LST_C').getInfo();

    // 6. Validation & Final Answer checks
    if (meanA === null || meanG === null || isNaN(meanA) || isNaN(meanG)) {
      console.log('Mean LST is null/NaN.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (meanA < -100 || meanA > 70 || meanG < -100 || meanG > 70) {
      console.log('Unrealistic LST values detected.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Print concise evidence
    const fmt = (v) => (typeof v === 'number' ? v.toFixed(2) : String(v));
    console.log(`PointA (63.8577,-22.4137) LST_C: ${fmt(meanA)} °C`);
    console.log(`Grindavik (~63.8420,-22.4330) LST_C: ${fmt(meanG)} °C`);

    // 7. Final comparison
    const answer = meanA > meanG ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
